get_config_files: get all DensePose configuration YAML files from the base configs directory
get_evolution_config_files: get all evolution variant configuration files for DensePose model testing
get_hrnet_config_files: get all HRNet backbone configuration files for DensePose model testing
get_quick_schedules_config_files: get all quick schedule configuration files for fast DensePose training runs
get_model_config: load a DensePose model configuration from a YAML file and return the cfg object
get_model: build a DensePose model from a configuration YAML file using detectron2
setup: load and freeze a DensePose configuration then run default_setup for testing
